operator: Trancid – Transporte Coletivo Cidade de Divinópolis (Consórcio TransOeste, lead operator)
notes:
Mode: urban bus only (route_type 3) — Divinópolis has no metro/light-rail/BRT/suburban rail, so METRO/RAIL-FIRST does not apply.

WHAT IS FAITHFUL (well-evidenced):
- Route list: all 32 Trancid lines, with exact short names + destinations, taken from the operator's own itinerario.php line selector (trancid.com.br) cross-checked against onibus.online. This matches the real network.
- Line 01 (Halim Souki / Bom Pastor): FULL real published schedule encoded — 26 weekday, 19 Saturday, 18 Sunday departures per direction (both ida + volta), sourced verbatim from onibus.online line-01 timetable. Operating window 05:05–22:40, ~29–30 min run time confirmed by Moovit.
- Agency, timezone (America/Sao_Paulo), calendar (weekday/Saturday/Sunday services).

WHAT IS APPROXIMATE (lower confidence):
- STOPS: intermediate stop lists with per-stop coordinates could NOT be obtained. Moovit line pages (which hold ~1,672 stops) are JavaScript-rendered and returned no content via fetch; the operator's itinerario.php embeds a Google-Maps JS route with no static stop text; the horário portals list only termini. OSM Overpass and Nominatim were both unreachable/blocked from this environment. Rather than invent ~1,600 fake stops, each route is modeled with its two REAL named bairro termini plus a shared central hub (Centro). 38 stops total.
- STOP COORDINATES: Only two anchors are precise WGS-84 — city center (-20.13889,-44.88389, from Wikipedia/geografos) and Padre Eustáquio via Rua Lima (-20.17346,-44.85037, geocoded). The other bairro-terminal coordinates are honest approximate centroids offset around the city center by known relative bairro position; they are indicative (within ~1-2 km), NOT surveyed stop locations.
- Lines other than 01: exact per-line timetables were not scraped, so each has one representative trip per direction (WEEKDAY) on an even headway across the network's published operating window (~05:00–22:00). The full generated feed (not shown here) contains 3,349 trips using ~40 min weekday / 60 min Sat / 90 min Sun headways; this reduced payload carries line 01's complete real schedule plus one ida+volta per remaining route to stay within size limits.

SOURCES USED: trancid.com.br/itinerario.php (official line list), onibus.online/mg/divinopolis (route names + line-01 real times), moovitapp.com Divinópolis 5097 (network size, line-01 stop count/run time), horariodeonibus.net (line-01 times cross-check). Consórcio TransOeste is the consortium; Trancid is the operating brand. Fare context: R$4,15 cash / R$3,65 DivPass (not part of GTFS core).

Confidence 0.42 reflects: route roster and line-01 schedule are real and accurate; but stop geometry, most intermediate stops, and non-01 exact timetables are representative rather than surveyed.
